description: Search companies by name (`q`). Returns up to 10 matches with the company name, logo URL, domain, industry, size, location and LinkedIn URL; pass the LinkedIn URL to get_company_profile for the full profile. The result has the full v3 answer in `data`, the credits charged for the call in `creditCost` and the `requestId` to quote to support.
name: search_companies
title: Search Companies
